payload.title: Customer Support Specialist, AR & Billing
payload.description:
Description

CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST, AR & BILLING

MOUNTAIN VIEW, CA - HYBRID 3 days per week in office

 

EGNYTE YOUR CAREER. SPARK YOUR PASSION.

Egnyte is a place where we spark opportunities for amazing people. We believe that every role has a great impact, and every Egnyter should be respected. When joining Egnyte, you’re not just landing a new career, you become part of a team of Egnyters that are doers, thinkers, and collaborators who embrace and live by our values:

  • Invested Relationships
  • Fiscal Prudence
  • Candid Conversations

 

ABOUT EGNYTE

Egnyte is the secure multi-cloud platform for content security and governance that enables organizations to better protect and collaborate on their most valuable content. Established in 2008, Egnyte has democratized cloud content security for more than 22,000 organizations, helping customers improve data security, maintain compliance, prevent and detect ransomware threats, and boost employee productivity on any app, any cloud, anywhere. For more information, visit www.egnyte.com.

 

Our Order-to-Cash team enables Egnyte's customers to access what they've purchased without delay and be billed accurately by managing the full process from signed order to collected payment. We are seeking a Customer Support Specialist to streamline the process for our customers. The successful candidate will have a record of success in time management, customer relations and thinking outside the box to find optimal and scalable solutions to issues that may arise.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Answer internal/ external customer inquiries promptly/ efficiently and professionally through Zendesk and Salesforce
  • Collaborate with internal teams (billing, collections, sales) to resolve customer concerns, via phone, email, virtual meetings
  • Use critical-thinking and problem-solving skills to investigate and resolve billing issues
  • Proficiency in leveraging CRM systems and customer support platforms to manage cases and track interactions
  • Execute and propose processes that will help automate/ expedite process/ procedures
  • Other AdHoc as needed

 

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High degree of attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Excellent verbal and written communication including understanding how to tailor messages towards different audiences and conveying the objective clearly
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Experience with Salesforce, reviewing contracts/ orders and purchase orders
  • Good understanding of payment processes, billing systems
  • Experience with subscription-based or digital goods business models is strongly preferred

 

COMPENSATION:

  • Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across multiple U.S. geographic locations, and pay varies based on defined markets. The standard base pay range for this position across the U.S. is $95k - $105k annually. Pay varies by work location and may also be dependent on job-related skills, knowledge, and/or experience. During the interview and/or hiring process, your recruiter can share more information about the compensation package specific to the role and job location.

 

BENEFITS:

  • Competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits
  • 15 days of Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid holidays and sick time
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with a generous employer contribution and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
  • Up to 12wks of paid Parental and 10wks Adoption Leave to help you grow your family
  • Modern and collaborative offices located in Draper, UT; Raleigh, NC; Mountain View, CA; Reading, England, and Poznan, Poland
  • Gym, cell phone, and internet reimbursement
  • Free well-being apps such as Spring Health for Guardian are offered, as well access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Perks include discounted pet insurance, electronics, theme park tickets, travel, plus more
  • Your own Egnyte account with lifetime access
  • HealthJoy – a benefits navigation app that lets you access your benefits and get answers to your questions all in one place
  • One Medical virtual care, providing you with healthcare access across the country

 

Equal Employment Opportunity
Egnyte, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. Egnyte, Inc.'s management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, access to facilities and programs, and general treatment during employment.

 

At Egnyte, we embrace our unique differences and thrive on the individuality of our employees, our products, our customers, our investors, and our communities. Our global Egnyte Employee Communities (EECs) support representation and foster connectedness across our varied workplace. Egnyters are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work and to appreciate the many differences that collectively make Egnyte a higher-performing company and a great place to be.

Any employees with questions or concerns about equal employment opportunities in the workplace are encouraged to bring these issues to the attention of [email protected]. Egnyte, Inc. will not allow any form of retaliation against employees who raise issues of equal employment opportunity. If employees feel they have been subjected to any such retaliation, they should contact [email protected]. To ensure the workplace is free of artificial barriers, violation of this policy including any improper retaliatory conduct will lead to discipline, up to and including discharge. All employees must cooperate with all investigations conducted pursuant to this policy.

Our Go to Market Finance team enables Egnyte's revenue engine as a strategic partner to Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Revenue Operations, helping drive profitable and sustainable growth. The team combines financial expertise with operational insights to support executive decision-making across customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth initiatives.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Serve as a strategic finance partner to Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services and executive leadership
  • Manage key SaaS operating metrics including ARR, bookings, churn, retention, and sales productivity
  • Own bookings and ARR reporting, recurring revenue forecasting, annual operating plan models, GTM expense and headcount planning, and performance analysis that supports executive decision-making
  • Report to the Director, Finance - GTM, and collaborate and partner with Sales leadership, Sales operations, Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, HR, Legal, Finance leadership and Accounting teams
  • Continually improve forecasting methodologies, reporting accuracy, and planning processes
  • Enhance reporting automation and dashboard capabilities
  • No travel expectations at this time
  • 3 days per week on-site

 

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field
  • 5-8+ years of progressive FP&A experience, including experience supporting SaaS or subscription-based businesses
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics including ARR, MRR, bookings, churn, gross retention, net retention, CAC, and sales productivity metrics; experience in high-growth SaaS environments preferred
  • Advanced financial modeling and forecasting skills, along with advanced Excel and financial modeling expertise
  • Experience managing budgets and headcount planning processes
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and executive-level recommendations
  • Experience supporting Sales, Revenue Operations, or Customer Success organizations
  • Experience using CRM and reporting platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Anaplan, Tableau, or Power BI
  • MBA, CFA, or CPA designation preferred

Our Accounting team is looking for a Senior G/L Accountant to join our growing team in Mountain View, CA. The ideal candidate is professional, organized, and detail-oriented, and works well in a team environment.

 

This role is responsible for a broad range of accounting functions, including preparing journal entries, account analysis, and reconciliations, as well as monthly financial statements, financial audit preparation, accounting memos, and worldwide consolidation. The selected candidate will work independently with little supervision, demonstrating a high level of efficiency and accuracy. Since Egnyte is a fast-paced environment, the role requires someone who is adaptable and able to prioritize their workload. This position is a key contributor to a dynamic business environment and provides the opportunity to strengthen your understanding of both operational and technical accounting processes.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Period-end close activities, including complex journal entries, reconciliations, and analysis, as well as other duties in accordance with the company timelines and schedule
  • Manage the accurate and timely month-end procedures for high level key balance sheet and income statement accounts including preparing and reviewing journal entries, account analysis and reconciliations
  • Drive process establishment or improvement and system implementation for financial processes
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with various organizations within the company by providing financial insights and relevant analysis / reporting
  • Research technical accounting rules and regulations, provide and implement recommendations on accounting issues
  • Serve as a key contributor for the auditors and facilitate various audit requests
  • Create and implement high level accounting policies, procedures and controls
  • Support management in dynamic projects in a fast-growing company
  • Work on-site in the Mountain View office at least three days per week

 

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of progressive work experience
  • Big four public accounting experience or CPA preferred
  • ASC 842 experience preferred
  • Self-motivated and a problem solver with a "can-do" mentality and a strong desire to drive changes
  • A team player mentality and the ability to work independently
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel with the capability of manipulating, analyzing, and reporting large sets of data
  • NetSuite, Coupa and Blackline experience preferred
  • Ability to prioritize and juggle multiple tasks while meeting deadlines
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Excellent written and oral communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills
  • Ad hoc projects
